text:
eva_s: Heads up — secret-scanner flagged long-lived AWS creds embedded inside a model checkpoint in s3://ml-checkpoints/train-job-4321. Scanner found two AccessKey IDs in the checkpoint metadata.

mike_infra: omg. which bucket/prefix exactly?

eva_s: s3://ml-checkpoints/train-job-4321/checkpoint-2026-03-22.tar.gz -> metadata/manifest.json contains keys under 'saved_env'.

tara_data: confirmed, I can reproduce locally with the scanner rule. It's the trainer VM IAM key that got dumped into the env at checkpoint time.

sam_prod: status impact? any public exposure?

eva_s: no public buckets; access seems limited to internal roles but keys are long-lived and used by some CI jobs. Treat as high-priority rotate and restrict.

mike_infra: I'll revoke the IAM keys immediately and create replacements. Action items: 1) revoke exposed keys 2) force-run all CI workflows that used them 3) scan repos/artefacts for other leaks 4) tighten checkpoint write processes

tara_data: can you list the IAM principal? I have a model training run that needs remediation steps so we can re-run without leaking creds again.

mike_infra: principal: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/trainer-ec2. Keys: AKIAEXAMPLE1 and AKIAEXAMPLE2 (from scanner). Revocation in progress.

deploy-bot: [automated] Created ticket S-5312: "Rotate leaked trainer IAM keys + CI re-run" assigned to infra on priority P0. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/S-5312

security-bot: [scan] Historical sweep queued: running full repo & bucket scan for similar patterns, ETA ~45m.

eva_s: Immediate mitigations (do these now):
- mike: revoke keys and add explicit deny-inline policy for trainer-ec2 to write to /ml-checkpoints/*
- tara: re-run training job with temp role via sts:AssumeRole (dont embed creds in checkpoints)
- sam: kick the CI pipelines that used the keys, regenerate any tokens and rotate service accounts
- all: run `./tools/secret-scanner --path s3://ml-checkpoints --pattern AKIA` and grep checkpoints for 'AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID'

mike_infra: revoke done. Created temp role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/trainer-temp with STS-only and limited S3 PutObject to ml-checkpoints/retries. Added deny policy to user/trainer-ec2.

tara_data: re-run scheduled. Patch to trainer: remove ENV export of AWS keys and use boto3 default session with role. Pushed PR: https://github.com/redwood/ml-trainer/pull/278 :thumbsup:

sam_prod: CI tokens rotated, kicked all jobs that referenced old keys. Observability: no failed production calls observed.

mike_infra: checklist for teams (short):
- rotate any keys containing the two AccessKey prefixes
- search your checkpoints & artifacts for credentials and re-upload sanitized artifacts
- stop storing env secrets in model metadata; use role-assume or secrets manager

eva_s: Compliance/inventory ask: we need a list of runs that wrote to that prefix between 2026-03-01 and 2026-03-22. Tara, can you produce run IDs?

tara_data: pulling logs now, will post IDs in 15m.

security-bot: [automated] Completed quick repo scan: 6 matches (dev-only forks). Creating follow-up tickets for each.

sam_prod: quick note for SRE: add an object lock or lifecycle policy to avoid accidental public copy of archived checkpoints.

eva_s: postmortem will be required for the training infra team. Drafting sec advisory and required remediation timeline: 24h key rotation done (in progress), 72h artifact sweep, 7d postmortem.

mike_infra: echo — I'll update S-5312 with status and close when CI re-runs are green.

tara_data: run IDs: run-20260305-18, run-20260312-07, run-20260320-03. Those wrote to that prefix. I'll attach sanitized manifests to S-5312.

eva_s: thanks. If anyone finds other credentials in checkpoints, DM me directly and tag @security. :warning:

mike_infra: done — rotated keys, CI restarted, infra deny policy applied. Marking mitigation complete for now but keep scanning. :lock:

security-bot: [automated] Full bucket sweep finished: 0 public exposures found; 12 private artifacts flagged for manual review. See S-5312 for details.

eva_s: closing the immediate thread — follow-ups will live in S-5312. Great job moving fast. :raised_hands:
